```{r}
mpg01<-rep(0,nrow(Auto))
mpg01[Auto[,'mpg']>median(Auto[,'mpg'])]<-1
mpg01=as.factor(mpg01)
auto01=data.frame(Auto,mpg01)
table(mpg01)
```
```{r}
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
boxplot(acceleration~mpg01,data,main="Accel~mpg01")
boxplot(weight~mpg01,data,main="weight~mpg01")
boxplot(horsepower~mpg01,data,main="horsep~mpg01")
boxplot(displacement~mpg01,data,main="disp~mpg01")
```
```{r}
training_data=auto01[1:196,]
testing_data=auto01[196:392,]

```
```{r}
logit.fit=glm(mpg01~horsepower+displacement,family=binomial,data=training_data)
summary(logit.fit)
```
```{r}
logit_pred=predict(logit.fit,testing_data[,c('horsepower','weight','displacement')])
logit_class=ifelse(logit_pred>0.5,1,0)
table(logit_class,testing_data[,'mpg01'])

```
